name: data-export-section
title: Data export section
description: The right of access without a support ticket: pick what to include and a format, request the export, and follow earlier ones by status and expiry.
docs: Data in, callbacks out: pass the groups, the earlier exports and onRequest. While an export is preparing (or onRequest is pending) the button rests and the card says it will email the person; add the new export to `exports` with status "preparing" and flip it to "ready" with a size, expiresAt and href when it is done. Dates use the locale and timeZone props (UTC by default); pass `now` to pin the relative "Expires in 5 days". title, description and headingLevel (2 or 3) rename the heading and set its level.
